title: How good is your job? – B2 English Listening Test

seo.title: How good is your job? – B2 English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: Listening comprehension practice test for pre-advanced students (CEFR B2 level). Jobs and work. English listening test.

parts:
B2 English Listening Test

Listen to an interview with a worker about his job, and for questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.
See the full list of B2 listening tests
Questions

choices.html: He'd rather have a well-paid job than an interesting job.
He wants an interesting job, even if it's badly paid.
He will do unpaid hours if it allows him to further his career.

questions.prompt: What is Toby's view of working hours?

choices.html: He will do extra hours in order to get a promotion.
He works overtime because he needs the money.
He avoids working any more hours than necessary.

questions.prompt: What is Toby's view of work flexibility?

choices.html: Luckily, he does not require flexible working hours.
His working conditions are flexible enough for his needs.
He wishes that his work offered more flexibility.

questions.prompt: What is Toby's view of vacation time?

choices.html: He can't travel to the places he'd like to go.
Vacation time is not very important to him.
He wishes he had more vacation time.
The time he spends commuting is increasing.
He finds commuting easier now than in the past.
He feels lucky that his commute to work is shorter now.

questions.prompt: What is Toby's view of his colleagues?

choices.html: Team-building days have helped him build work relationships.
He gets on well with all his colleagues, and that helps make his job less tedious.
He doesn't see eye to eye with some of his colleagues.

questions.prompt: What is Toby's view of job security?

choices.html: Luckily, his job is secure.
He is uncertain about the future of his job.
His job is temporary, so he's looking for more work.
